message: net `SO` joins ["f.so","u.cs"], roles ["tri_state","output"]: a pairing the KiCad baseline warns about (an output with a tri-state pin, a bidirectional pin with a rail, a tri-state pin with a power input or an open drain, a bidirectional pin on a ground-typed net); make sure only one of them drives at a time.

net `VCC` joins ["j.pos","u.io"], roles ["power_out","bidirectional"]: a pairing the KiCad baseline warns about (an output with a tri-state pin, a bidirectional pin with a rail, a tri-state pin with a power input or an open drain, a bidirectional pin on a ground-typed net); make sure only one of them drives at a time.
